Overview

What virtual assistance covers — and who it’s for.

DefinitionVirtual assistance is remote administrative and operational support — such as email, scheduling, data entry, research and customer service — delivered by a dedicated assistant working inside your tools.

Executives at growing companies spend a startling share of their week on work that doesn’t need them: rescheduling meetings, chasing approvals, updating the CRM, formatting decks, digging through inboxes. It’s not that the work doesn’t matter. It’s that it pulls your most expensive people away from decisions that do.

Akrostech virtual assistants are vetted professionals, not task-marketplace freelancers. Each one learns your preferences, your tools and your standards through a written playbook, then takes ownership of a defined set of responsibilities. Need more coverage? We add another trained assistant to the same pod — no new hiring cycle.

It’s ideal for founders and executives drowning in admin, operations teams stretched across too many systems, and customer-facing teams that need faster response times without adding full-time headcount.

FAQ

Virtual Assistance, answered.

The questions decision-makers ask us before they sign. Something missing? Ask us directly.

What kinds of tasks can a virtual assistant handle?

Any repeatable work that can be done remotely: email and calendar management, travel booking, CRM updates, data entry, research, document formatting, customer support and project coordination.

Will my assistant work during my business hours?

Yes. Your assistant’s shift is aligned to your working day, so they are online for live requests, meetings and same-day turnaround.

How do you keep our accounts secure?

Assistants work under NDA with the minimum access each task needs, ideally through a password manager, and you can revoke access at any moment.

Can we scale from part-time to full-time?

Yes. You can start part-time, move to a full-time dedicated assistant, or add more assistants to the same pod as your needs grow.

What happens if our assistant is unavailable?

Every client has a documented playbook and a trained backup, so cover during leave or sickness is seamless.
